question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval actions be permanently bound to the proposal version displayed to the operator, so a proposal revised after review must be reviewed and approved again?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but this is a deliberate user-visible approval and compatibility policy rather than a mechanical bug fix; the repository policy treats approval, fallback, and persisted workflow behavior as owner decisions.

options.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
options.body: Merge the preview feature with fail-closed stale approval prompts, preserving direct Proposal-ID lifecycle compatibility outside the approval gate.

options.title: Keep approvals version-agnostic
options.body: Do not merge the version-binding portion and retain the existing ability for a pending approval prompt to act on the current proposal state.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR until a Skill Workshop owner specifies the long-term approval semantics and operator recovery flow.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
recommendation.body: Merge the preview feature with fail-closed stale approval prompts, preserving direct Proposal-ID lifecycle compatibility outside the approval gate.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent Skill Workshop lifecycle-approval policy surface.
